temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work; when Jose asks, she says it is nothing really and just personal stuff, then thanks him for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has usually seemed vibrant and normal at work, with no known troubles.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - his suspicion that something is troubling her becomes more concrete, though she does not disclose details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is dealing with some personal difficulty and may not want to share it yet; she appreciates his supportive offer.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and empathetic, with cautious uncertainty.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be available to listen and support Patricia without pushing her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; later she confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and says financial planning or budgeting help could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is dealing with an undisclosed personal difficulty and appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - the vague personal trouble is now identified as financial stress, and she seems open to his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and overwhelmed by bills, and may accept budgeting or financial-planning support from him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and a wish to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer budgeting or financial-planning help and discuss it when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose apologizes if his financial-planning offer felt like prying; Patricia says she did not think he was prying and is grateful he offered help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and open to help, but Jose worries his offer may have overstepped her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - his worry is eased; Patricia reassures him that his concern is welcome and not intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his support as a friend and does not view him as prying; he can help while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially worried or anxious, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Patricia as a respectful friend, offering help without prying or pressuring.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good and she is planning a quiet weekend at home; she thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind but does not seek further help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia welcomes his supportive concern and does not view him as intrusive, but Jose senses she may prefer to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - her low-key response strengthens his sense that she appreciates concern but wants privacy and normalcy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but likely prefers to handle her issues privately for now; Jose should stay supportive without pressing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern and acceptance, with mild restraint.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain friendly check-ins and offer availability casually while giving Patricia space.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things and thanks Jose for checking in; she says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy and handling her issues herself; Jose should stay supportive without pressing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change - her response confirms she values his support and is managing things, while not asking for specific help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is coping and appreciates Jose's steady, low-pressure support; she will ask if she needs help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue being a supportive presence and regular check-in, helping if asked while respecting her autonomy.
